rows.name: Harmonics: Gartley / Bat / Butterfly / Crab / Shark / Cypher

rows.name: Candlestick pattern families
notes: Rule-based candle patterns; not all TA-Lib patterns implied.

rows.name: Lorentzian Classification / kNN
notes: CORTEX analog kNN is a different algorithm from Lorentzian Classification; current injection flag not runtime verified.

rows.name: COT Index / net positioning
notes: Confidence adjustment is strategy/preset and data dependent; COT service can use fallback data.

rows.name: Open Interest / price-OI regimes
notes: COT open-interest context, not a full live derivatives price/OI regime engine.

rows.name: Options IV / skew / term structure / gamma
notes: Using a VIX reference does not establish an options-chain IV/skew/gamma engine.

rows.name: Intermarket ratios / rolling correlation / beta
notes: Actual gold macro correlations; many legacy correlation feature names are fallback only.

rows.name: Seasonality / session statistics
notes: Seasonality enters smart-setup recommendation and oil temporal modifiers; not all calendar methods.

rows.name: EIA inventories / crude time spreads
notes: This EIA fetch returns None by design; EIA calendar context elsewhere is not an actual inventory-surprise feed.

rows.name: Gold real-yield / dollar / GVZ context
notes: Partial family: dollar/nominal US10Y/VIX; no claim that real yields or GVZ are model inputs.
Raw VIX/DXY context; source explicitly rejects treating the historical macro→gold relation as directional proof.

rows.name: DAX session / breadth / volatility context
notes: DAX-specific CAPREV session profile; breadth and DAX implied-volatility are not implied.
